But the cited line numbers do not exist (merge.go is 344 lines, not 435; types.go/schema.go/runtime_defaults.go refs also off) and the -250 LOC estimate is inflated: merge.go can shrink by roughly 80-100 lines, args.go by ~30. No evidence of an actual dropped field or live bug, so not high. Existing merge/wire/args tests (merge_test 464 lines) already pin behavior.
revised_fix_plan: Add the completeness test first (every Layer field has a schema row and is covered by merge/ToArgs/FromWire/ToWire or an explicit exclusion). Then add generic mergeScalar/mergePtr helpers and convert merge.go block by block; keep app_replay_size, system prompt modes, env, mcps, model_fallbacks, enabled_plugins explicit. Fold finding 4's clonePtr into this PR. Skip the ToArgs table unless it measurably shrinks. Expect about -120 net.

title: launchconfig and hubedge atomic writes are ad hoc and weaker than the hub's other stores
note: Verified: launchconfig/io.go:53 writeAtomicFS uses fixed path+'.tmp' with O_TRUNC (concurrent saves share one tmp) and fsyncs the file but not the directory; hubedge/auth_token.go:105 os.WriteFile (no fsync) then rename, and the loader treats an empty file as absent (auth_token.go:~90) so a crash could rotate the token. hubcore/state_file.go:35 writeStateFileAtomic is the stronger version. The plan overlooks that internal/plugins/atomic.go and transcriptindex already have helpers, so a new shared package may be unnecessary; whether concurrent SaveLayer is reachable is unproven.
revised_fix_plan: Fix hubedge first (temp+fsync+rename+dir sync with fsdurability tolerance) with a test; then make launchconfig use a unique temp name and dir sync. Evaluate reusing internal/plugins/atomic.go before extracting anything new.
